verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, a Postman collection, and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema, but nowhere mentions official client SDKs in any language. An OpenAPI schema is only a building block a developer could use to generate a client; it is not an official SDK, so it earns no credit. The axis clearly applies to an API-first SaaS product, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.
